perks.summary: +20% handling while wielding a one-handed melee weapon; with RBM posture on, it also cuts the posture the troop loses when blocking or parrying (about 17% less).
perks.conditions: Main-hand weapon is a one-handed melee weapon. The posture reduction needs rbmAiEnabled + postureEnabled. Halved at sea (NavalReduced).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter on the agent's own CharacterObject -> HandlingMultiplier; not patched by RBM
captain half (+30 one-handed skill to the formation); the captain is a hero
RBM posture: divides block/parry posture cost by the perk-adjusted handling, any CharacterObject

perks.rbm: RBMAI multiplies HandlingMultiplier by stamina (AgentStats.cs:310), which keeps the perk. RBMAI posture adds its own WrappedHandles read.

perks.summary: Shield bashes stun 50% longer; the +50% bash damage never applies, in vanilla either, because that check sits behind an IsMeleeWeapon test that shields never pass.
perks.conditions: A shield in the off hand (stun multiplier is only set while a shield is wielded). Halved at sea.

sites.why: own CharacterObject -> ShieldBashStunDurationMultiplier (engine-read driven property), shield wielded; RBM does not touch it

dead branch: `else if (currentUsageItem.IsShield)` is nested inside `if (currentUsageItem.IsMeleeWeapon)`, and shield items carry no MeleeWeapon flag (vanilla and RBMCombat_shields.xml), so the bash damage bonus is unreachable
captain half (shield-wall damage reduction); hero captain only

perks.rbm: RBM's kick/bash damage (DamageRework.Core.cs:398-429) replaces vanilla's flat bash magnitude, but the amplification branch was already dead. Stun multiplier untouched.

perks.summary: +5% damage with one-handed axes and maces (also on hits against shields).
perks.conditions: Attacking with a one-handed melee weapon of class Mace or OneHandedAxe. Halved at sea.

sites.why: attacker's own CharacterObject; CalculateDamage still runs on RBM's InflictedDamage (Mission.cs:6542)

perks.rbm: None; damage-model perks apply on top of RBM's damage.

perks.summary: +2% swing speed with one-handed melee weapons.
perks.conditions: Main-hand weapon is a one-handed melee weapon. Halved at sea.
perks.rbm: RBMAI's SetWeaponSkillEffectsOnAgent replacement runs before the perk step; the later stamina scaling (AgentStats.cs:317) is multiplicative. Perk kept.

perks.summary: +5% damage with one-handed melee weapons while mounted, on land only.
perks.conditions: Mounted, attacking with a one-handed melee weapon. LandOnly: nothing in naval battles.

sites.why: attacker's (rider's) own CharacterObject, gated on having a mount

perks.summary: The wielded shield's weight stops counting toward weapon encumbrance (vanilla adds 1.5x its weight), which slightly raises movement speed, combat speed and acceleration.
perks.conditions: A shield (CanBlockRanged) wielded in the off hand. Gain is small and can be swallowed by the speed clamps for light, high-Athletics troops.

sites.why: characterObject.GetPerkValue(perk, env, true, out _) on the agent's own character; feeds WeaponsEncumbrance -> MaxSpeedMultiplier, CombatMaxSpeedMultiplier, TopSpeedReachDuration

perks.rbm: RBM's UpdateHumanStats postfix only resets the shield missile size; speed fields are only multiplied by stamina (AgentStats.cs:314). Perk kept.

perks.summary: +2 hit points.
perks.conditions: Applied when the agent spawns (BaseHealthLimit from MaxHitPoints() while Mission.Current is set).

sites.why: AddPerkBonusForCharacter(BattleEnvironment.Any) on the troop; Agent.Character setter sets BaseHealthLimit = MaxHitPoints() (Agent.cs:1438), and InitializeAgentStats' non-hero branch builds HealthLimit from it (SandboxAgentStatCalculateModel.cs:53)
hero HP refresh on perk unlock

perks.rbm: None; RBM does not patch max health.

perks.summary: +20% damage with one-handed melee weapons while the off hand is empty; the other half (double tournament renown) is hero-only.
perks.conditions: One-handed melee attack with nothing in the off hand. Halved at sea.

perks.summary: -20% damage to the troop's shield when it blocks from the wrong side; with RBM posture on, the same block also costs 20% less posture.
perks.conditions: Shield block on the incorrect side. Posture part needs rbmAiEnabled + postureEnabled. Halved at sea.

sites.why: victim's own CharacterObject; a block's InflictedDamage is the shield damage and still passes CalculateDamage
RBM posture on incorrect shield blocks
captain half (missile catch area); also overwritten by RBM

perks.rbm: RBM's shield-damage rewrite (OverrideDamageCalcShield) still feeds Mission.GetAttackCollisionResults -> CalculateDamage, so the reduction applies. RBM adds a posture equivalent.

perks.summary: RBM's own effect (the vanilla bigger shield catch area is overwritten by RBM): missiles blocked with the raised shield cost 25% less posture and stamina, do 20% less damage to the shield, and a pilum gets 15% less of its throw through the shield.
perks.conditions: Missile blocked with a wielded shield (not a shield on the back). Shield damage and pilum parts need rbmCombatEnabled; the posture/stamina part needs rbmAiEnabled + postureEnabled. Halved at sea (NavalReduced). A formation captain with the perk gives the other troops half of it (land only), capped at the full effect.

sites.why: CharacterObject.GetPerkValue(perk, CurrentBattleEnvironment, true, out value) on the shield holder's own character; the captain half the same way with isPrimaryEffect false. Tuning constants there
RBM posture: missile shield-hit posture (and the stamina derived from it) x0.75
missile damage to a raised shield x0.8 (before CalculateShieldDamage); also lowers the engine's CanPenetrateShield threshold test (Impale)
share of a pilum's throw through the shield x0.85 (shallower shank, weaker wound)
vanilla: AttributeShieldMissileCollisionBodySizeAdder (+0.01) while a shield is wielded; overwritten by RBM
RBM assigns AttributeShieldMissileCollisionBodySizeAdder = 0.01f after the whole stat build (kept on purpose)

perks.rbm: Bypass map #10: the vanilla catch-size effect is still overwritten by design; RBM replaced it with the three effects above (RBMConfig.ArrowCatcher). The in-game perk text is rewritten to match when RBM Combat is on.

perks.summary: Ignores 10% of the target's armor on hits with one-handed weapons (and shield bashes); not with two-handed weapons or polearms, though the description says melee attacks.
